name: walk
description: Walk — on-device footage triage for photographers. Scans video on Apple silicon with a whole-frame luminance-rise detector and an on-device Vision classifier, and returns candidate frames with their measurements and a written thumbnail. Ships an MCP server; requires macOS 26 on arm64.

metadata.compatibilityTier: MCP-host-full-operation ONLY, AND macOS 26 or later on Apple silicon (arm64) ONLY — this plugin ships a native Mach-O binary, not a script
metadata.requiresForFullOperation: a host able to launch stdio MCP servers, running macOS 26+ on arm64. There is no Intel build and no non-Apple port: the engine links Vision, CoreML and AVFoundation directly, which is the whole reason the classification runs on-device and costs no tokens.
metadata.note: PHASE 1 SHIPS THE ENGINE AND NO JUDGMENT. Decision #534 rules that the coaching criteria set ships inside this plugin; it does not ship in this phase. Until it does, every scan returns coaching.available=false together with the reason and the paths searched — read that field rather than inferring a verdict, and do not substitute one. A criteria set installed at ~/Library/Application Support/Walk/criteria.json, or named in WALK_CRITERIA, is loaded and rendered from. Hosts that omit mcpServers plugins will not install this pack, and hosts below the macOS/arch floor get a server that advertises zero tools and states the reason rather than failing silently.
